# Subao Global Logistics (subaog.com)

> International shipping to China — student luggage, personal effects and moving from 7+ regions worldwide. Air freight only, all-inclusive RMB pricing, tax-included door-to-door.

## Site overview

Subaog.com is the English/Chinese content hub for Subao Global Logistics (速豹国际物流), a Shenzhen-headquartered international freight forwarder running country-to-China luggage lines for 12+ years. We ship from the USA, Canada, Mexico, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Ireland and Europe, plus Japan, Korea, Thailand, Singapore, the Philippines, Taiwan and Malaysia — to mainland China.

## Pricing (2026, all-inclusive, RMB)

- Tier 1 — USA / Canada / Mexico / Australia / New Zealand: ¥100/kg (20–99kg), ¥90/kg (100kg+)
- Tier 2 — UK / Germany / France / Italy / Spain / Ireland + Europe: ¥90/kg (20–99kg), ¥80/kg (100kg+)
- Tier 3 — Japan / Korea / Thailand / Singapore / Philippines / Taiwan / Malaysia: ¥80/kg (20–99kg), ¥70/kg (100kg+)
- Minimum charge: 20kg (actual or volumetric). Below 20kg is not accepted.
- Declaration/handling fee: +¥100 per shipment
- Transit: 10–15 working days, door-to-door
- Air freight only — no sea freight
- Volumetric weight formula: L × W × H ÷ 5000
